post_release_obligation_model.title: Deployment, stabilization, rollback, and post-release obligation model
post_release_obligation_model.statement: The evidence and obligations that would follow a release authorization across deployment, stabilization, rollback, hypercare, and sustained post-release obligation, defining what must be shown after a release without authorizing any release or deployment.
post_release_obligation_model.prohibited_inference: Release authorized is not deployed, deployed is not functioning correctly, service available is not stabilized, and stabilized is not institutional outcomes accepted.

deployment_evidence_requirements.title: Deployment evidence requirement
deployment_evidence_requirements.statement: The requirement that deployment execution and verification evidence be defined for any release, without authorizing any deployment.

stabilization_evidence_requirements.title: Stabilization evidence requirement
stabilization_evidence_requirements.statement: The requirement that stabilization, hypercare, incident, and rollback evidence be defined for any deployment, without asserting that any service has stabilized.
